nodes.summary: Compile the dashboard view of a cem/1.0 stable map and its OCM against an expected base and target
usage: corvint-dashboard-snapshot cem-stable --root ROOT --cem PATH --ocm PATH --expected-base OID --target OID --artifact-root DIR
nodes.example: corvint-dashboard-snapshot cem-stable --root ROOT --cem PATH --ocm PATH --expected-base OID --target OID --artifact-root DIR

nodes.summary: Compile the roadmap snapshot from a Tasks store, receipts, docs state and requirements; --atm is the legacy spelling of --tasks
usage: corvint-dashboard-snapshot roadmap --root ROOT --tasks BINARY --store DIR --generated-at TIME [--receipts-dir DIR] [--docs-state FILE] [--requirements FILE] [--atm BINARY]
nodes.example: corvint-dashboard-snapshot roadmap --root ROOT --tasks BINARY --store DIR --generated-at TIME
